description: This Java class 'MenuPreviewRenderer' generates a visual preview of Android menu layouts for design-time rendering within the Android Studio environment. It constructs XML layout hierarchies representing menus, action bars, and related UI components, simulating how menus appear on devices based on API level and theme settings.

classes.name: MenuPreviewRenderer
classes.description: A class that creates a visual preview of Android menus and action bars by constructing XML layout hierarchies for design-time rendering.

methods.name: MenuPreviewRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with rendering service and XML file context.

methods.name: isLightTheme
methods.description: Determines if the current theme is a light theme based on resource resolution.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds and returns an XML layout parser representing the menu preview.

methods.name: createActionBar
methods.description: Creates a simulated action bar layout element.

methods.name: createMenuPopup
methods.description: Creates a popup menu layout element with appropriate background based on theme.

methods.name: addFidelityWarning
methods.description: Adds a warning message to the layout indicating the preview is approximate.

methods.name: addActionBar
methods.description: Adds a fake action bar with icons extracted from the root XML tag.

methods.name: populateMenu
methods.description: Populates the menu layout with menu items parsed from the XML root tag.

methods.name: readMenu
methods.description: Reads and returns a list of menu items from the root XML tag.

methods.name: addMenuItems
methods.description: Recursively adds menu items and groups from XML tags to the menu list.

methods.name: readGroup
methods.description: Reads group attributes from an XML tag to set menu group state.

methods.name: readItem
methods.description: Reads a menu item from an XML tag, considering group attributes.

methods.name: resetGroup
methods.description: Resets menu group attributes to default values.
